summary: Configured and verified a four-node distributed MinIO service with TLS on port 9000, persistent /srv/minio storage, erasure coding (EC:2), authenticated access, and reboot-safe systemd/UFW settings.
actions_performed: Installed mc access on node1 with /root/minio-admin.env
Installed shared CA and per-node validated TLS identities
Verified all four nodes healthy, authenticated, and 4/4 drives online
